19th-century Tilton hotel is a favorite for psychic medium, paranormal investigators

New Hampshire Chronicle | Oct. 28, 2026

TILTON, N.H. —

October is the time of year when many people think about ghosts and the afterlife.

Hearst Owned

What if you could contact someone in the afterlife? That is exactly what psychic mediums say they can do.

To learn more about this, we headed to a bed and breakfast on West Main Street in Tilton.

"It's a very historical property with outstanding woodwork; the craftsmanship is amazing," John Basiliere said.

The Basilieres own and operate the Black Swan Inn Bed and Breakfast.

"When people step in here, they feel like they've stepped back in time," Trish Basilere said.

The inn was originally built as a private residence in 1880.

In the early 1900s, it was home to one of Tilton's biggest names in business, Arthur S. Brown.

"He actually ended up inventing and manufacturing and patenting continuous woven endless belts, which later became the automotive fan belt for Henry Ford," Trisha Basiliere said.

John Basiliere said Brown's endless belt factory was down the street.

The Basilieres have owned the Black Swan Inn for 14 years and have carefully maintained its Victorian charm.

In that time, people have experienced a few unexplainable events here. For example, one person heard voices when no one was there.

"We've been here; we've heard a door close when there's nobody on the third floor," Trish Basilere.

The Basileres were once part of a paranormal investigative team and continue their fascination with the unexplained.

The inn's ambience is one of the reasons a Keene-based psychic medium loves it here.

"I've been coming in for three years. I could never get enough of this location," said Brandie Wells.

Wells and Jennifer Paone operate Soul Sisters: Beyond The Veil, through which they offer services like paranormal investigations, hypnosis and psychic medium events.

"Essentially, I'm channeling spirit. I'm allowing spirit to move through me. As spirit told me not long ago, I'm an interpreter for the dead," Wells said.

The women host regular events where Wells said she connects people with their dead loved ones.

"I always tell people you just have to see her, then you'll be a believer," Paone said. "Every single time there are people in absolute tears. It's healing for people. It's amazing to see that."

Wells said her skill isn't necessarily special; she's just better at tuning into a spirit energy we've probably all felt.

"It's kind of like you walk into a room and you can feel someone just had an argument," she said. "A vibration of the argument. The room feels heavy."

For paranormal investigating, Wells uses things like meters for electromagnetic fields and dousing rods to sense spirit energy. She said the energy can answer simple yes or no questions by steering the rods in your hands.

While we were at the inn, Wells said she connected with Belle Peabody, who lived in the inn during the early 1900s.

Inside the main seating area, Paone and Wells gathered a crowd of about 15 people for a psychic medium dinner event.

Wells started by having the crowd close their eyes and listen to her voice.

"I want you to pause for a moment and ask in your mind, is there anyone in spirit in this room willing to come forward for me?" she said.

Paone records the psychic event as Wells tries to pick up on spirit energy.

Wells says she starts sensing spirits.

"So I'm connecting with someone's mother, struggling with her role as a mom," she said. Then another. "So I feel like it's an uncle coming through with a father. Does anyone connect to this right away?"

Within a few minutes, a woman in the room speaks up, saying she knows the person being described.

Wells said the message from that man, "That's his message. 'I'm still here with you. I hope you feel that. You haven't said a word. I'm sorry, he's coming in so strong."

The woman responded, "It's my father."

Wells also connected with a woman. Another woman in the crowd thinks it may be her late mother.

"It's been hard because you want your mom to show up, to help you in this difficult time. Sometimes your communication is not the easiest," Wells said.

There are many people who don't believe communicating with spirits is possible. Wells said she is used to talking with skeptics.

"I would say to the skeptic, it's really important to understand we are spirits in human form. Just because we leave this earth body does not mean we are gone from this earth plane," she said.
